paper_title: Token-Level Uncertainty Estimation for Large Language Model Reasoning
caption: Left: Uncertainty estimations in different token decoding temperature . Right: Influence of token decoding temperature on uncertainty-based AUROC scores.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates uncertainty estimations across different token decoding temperatures. The x-axis is labeled "Decoding Temperature" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick labels at every 0.2 increments. The y-axis is labeled "Temperature" and employs a linear scale from 0.000 to 0.175. A line in red with circular markers shows a gradual increase from 0.125 at x = 0.0 to 0.154 at x = 0.8. A line in blue with triangular markers begins at 0.156 at x = 0.0, descends to 0.153 at x = 0.2, increases to 0.156 at x = 0.4, and ultimately reaches 0.174 at x = 0.8. Finally, a line in gray with square markers starts at 0.124 at x = 0.0, increases to 0.127 at x = 0.2, descends to 0.126 at x = 0.4, and rises to 0.153 at x = 0.8.
